main_text.l: fupra tempora dextra, qui post sex horas
inventus fuit mortuus in lecto. Trifte
spectaculum! Iussi sumus ab Senatu A-
statim apparuit spuma circa os copiosa,
tempora dicta livida, cum manifestà loci
depressione. Heic, inquam ego, est sedes
mali: oportet aperire caput! Cum igitur
lata erat, altera paulò brevior. Ablatà parte,
trabat tabulam utramque: hæc autem ex-
quantũ utraq; manu caua exhaurire nom
dum. Quod verò omnem superat admi-
ratio-nem, eo ipso loco, ex adverso fissura-
rum, dura mater tota erat ossea, Thaleri
ictum. Hoc os secum habuit D. SO-
cus, in vicino pago Masch/ aggrederetur

page.notes: The page is a scan of a book page with a mirrored/show-through text from the other side and fragments of the adjacent page at the left edge, which are not transcribed. Several words are uncertain due to blur (for example "sesquipalmum", "Masch", "superat admiratio-nem"); these were read as best possible and may contain errors. Some Latin words in the passage are rendered with long s as s; the original text is printed in mixed German and Latin.
